title: A Bayesian Threshold-Crossing Joint Model for Irregular, Assay-Floor-Censored Molecular Monitoring in Chronic Myeloid Leukemia — analysis code
description:
Code, Stan models and reproducible simulation workflow for a Bayesian joint model in which deep molecular response (DMR) is read as a first-hitting time of the latent biomarker trajectory rather than coded as a separate event.

No clinical data is included. The study cohort is identifiable patient health information and cannot be shared. A synthetic-cohort generator with the identical column schema is provided so the pipeline runs end-to-end; it verifies that the code executes but does not reproduce the reported estimates.

Contents: Stan models for the joint longitudinal-interval and multi-state threshold-crossing formulations, including Gaussian and Student-t observation models; R scripts for data preparation, fitting, prior sensitivity, leave-one-out model comparison and reporting; a self-contained ADEMP simulation study with sharded, checkpointed execution; and the generated tables and figures.
